title: Content API: Read and Write Content Items Over HTTP | Orchard Core
description:
A script, a mobile app or another service often has to create a content item, change one, or read one by its ID, without going through the admin.

The Contents module answers with three endpoints under api/content. They take and return the JSON of a content item, and they check an access token and the permissions of its role.

In this video:
• The three endpoints, and the JSON of a content item
• Authentication with access tokens from OpenID Connect
• The permissions each call needs, set on a role
• Creating an item, published or as a draft
• Reading an item by its ID
• Updating an item, published or as a draft
• Checking the result in the admin
• Deleting an item
• The status codes of the responses
